one_liner: A selective, grounded, failure-aware PR review agent: a fan-out of specialist reasoners over a diff, grounded in retrieved code, with every action on one time-ordered spine.
architecture_style: modular monolith (ADR-002): one process, inward-only dependencies, observability cross-cutting

diffing.purpose: parse unified diffs into files/hunks/changed-lines (unified-diff aware)

agents.purpose: baseline static reviewer + 4 LLM specialists + aggregator; all emit Findings

memory.purpose: code-chunk store + hybrid (semantic+exact) retrieval; Tiger/pgvector later, in-memory now

economics.purpose: BudgetGuard + cost repository + model routing advisor

orchestrator.purpose: graph/state/nodes fan-out; LangGraph impl behind core.workflow_engine (ADR-001)

hitl.purpose: confidence gate, approval queue, escalation, feedback, dispute

evaluation.purpose: golden PRs, baseline-vs-upgraded, LLM-as-judge, regression gate

security.purpose: prompt-injection guard, HMAC verify, RBAC, secret masking

cli.purpose: python -m grounded review/eval — local demo entrypoint (no external services)

invariants: DEPENDENCY RULE (ADR-002): core depends on nothing; every other module depends only inward. Any outer module can be deleted and inner ones still import. Enforced by tests/test_architecture.py.
ONE FINDING CONTRACT: every reviewer (baseline, single-LLM, or specialist) emits models.Finding and nothing else. The aggregator merges DATA, not prose.
NO LLM BEHIND A DETERMINISTIC DECISION: severity scoring, routing class, dedup, and the confidence gate are deterministic; only natural-language findings come from an LLM (agentic-swe-master Move 3).
GROUNDING: an upgraded finding without a code citation is invalid; retrieval provenance travels with the finding.
SWAP BEHIND A SEAM (ADR-001/003): orchestrator imports only core.workflow_engine; LLM only core.llm; memory backend swaps in-memory<->Tiger without touching callers.
DEGRADE SAFE: every outbound/agent step has a timeout; on failure the review completes with partial findings + a recorded degradation, never hangs and never posts a fabricated result.
EVENTS ARE APPEND-ONLY: every agent action is one immutable row on the spine; the whole review is reconstructable from it.

deferred_external_dependencies.Tiger Cloud (TimescaleDB + pgvector/pgve: M3/M4 — in-memory retrieval + SQLite events until then
deferred_external_dependencies.GitHub App (webhook + posting): M4 — CLI on a diff file until then
deferred_external_dependencies.Groq LLM provider (OpenAI-compatible, fr: M2 — FakeLLM (deterministic) for all tests; real GROQ_API_KEY gated behind BudgetGuard. Chat inference only; embeddings for M3 retrieval use a local model since Groq has no embeddings API.

adrs.ADR-001: Orchestration = LangGraph now, behind core.workflow_engine; swap to Temporal at scale (1 file).
adrs.ADR-003: One Tiger Cloud data spine (memory+truth+time); Redis stays as queue.
adrs.ADR-004: Cost control: BudgetGuard reads running daily cost and hard-blocks before an LLM call.
